elevation.$description: Elevation semantic tokens. These complete the surface roles: surface.raised and surface.overlay named the colour of a lifted plane without naming its shadow, so "raised" was only half-defined. Elevation is a real design concept that both design tools and production encode, and it needs a role of its own to survive a round trip.

raised.$description: Lifted just off the page — cards, panels. Pairs with surface.raised.

overlay.$description: Floating above the page — menus, popovers, dropdowns. Pairs with surface.overlay.

modal.$description: Above everything — dialogs and sheets that take focus from the page.
